_comment: Car-seat stroller adapter fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05 (batch S10). Glüxkind Car Seat Adapter (Clek's list calls it 'Universal Car Seat Adapter') for the Rosa Smart Stroller. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Glüxkind Car Seat Adapter
seatBrandsSupported: Clek Liing — a precision-fit adapter thoughtfully designed to pair the Clek Liing with the Glüxkind Rosa. Confirmed Clek Liing supported per Clek's list; Rosa is also certified for the Clek Liingo.

install.pieces: adapter unit (three-piece system: Rosa frame + adapter + Clek Liing car seat)
install.notes: Precision-fit; the Clek Liing clicks onto the adapter for a secure car-to-stroller transfer.

notes: $70 at Glüxkind DTC, in stock, made in Canada (SKU GKAC-GK00011). Purpose-built to mount the Clek Liing on the Rosa Smart Stroller; Glüxkind certifies Rosa for the Clek Liing and Clek Liingo. Glüxkind also sells the Clek Liing seat ($630) and a Clek Foonf set directly, indicating a close Clek partnership.
